visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed split band: copy panel in one half, image filling the other half edge to edge
Copy panel is ink (#131517) with white text by default; a section style (red, cyan, green, orange, light-grey) recolours it
Large heavy title (h1, h2 or h3 all styled the same), cyan subline on ink, CTA pinned to the bottom of the panel
Optional small mono icon above the title
Mobile: image stacked above the copy
Portrait option: profile band — circular ~250px headshot centred in its half, cyan name heading, white bold job title, small grey uppercase label and its white value
contentPattern: One row with two cells in any order
Image cell: a single picture and no text
Copy cell: optional icon paragraph (picture or :icon:) before the heading, a heading (h1/h2/h3), optional subline paragraph(s), an optional CTA paragraph (bold link becomes a button)
Portrait option uses the same cells: picture cell holds the headshot; copy cell holds the name heading, then paragraphs for job title, label (e.g. "Area of expertise") and value
usage: Promotional band that pairs one message and one call to action with a large image, e.g. the SEI Data Cloud teaser on /asset-managers, the About SEI page hero and the red 'Our history' band. With the portrait option it is the leader profile band on /about-sei/<leader> pages (e.g. Brad Burke).
reuseGuidance: Use for a single split image-and-copy band. Colour it with the section style rather than a new block; put the image on the left with the image-left option. For a picture behind the copy use hero; for several items use cards.
